column1: # Registry of static secrets sealed from secrets/.secrets via `just seal`.
# Add a row to add a secret. Values live in secrets/.secrets (gitignored), never here.
# ENVVAR prefixed `generate:` is auto-generated once and cached in secrets/.secrets.generated
# (gitignored) instead of requiring a value in secrets/.secrets — use for arbitrary internal
# shared secrets, never for credentials that must match an external system.
